Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 43, "heading": "CHAPTER 41. DORA’S AUNTS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u043-b0062", "target": "— Трэдлс, — сказал мой друг, заметив, что на него смотрят.", "source_sha256": "99caba3c3384495da4512950bde617123c2b7e8c6f5f5287d774432bdc2110de", "target_id": "ru-en85-u043-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a1bc2ed5515cce4b4e87b5856c5dee9dd6ae43a6ed6d0be1814028b612efb008"}, {"source_id": "en85-u043-b0063", "target": "— Прошу прощения. Из Внутреннего Темпла, если не ошибаюсь? — сказала мисс Кларисса, снова взглянув на моё письмо.", "source_sha256": "86fa7db8d8d633587d611ccad2896ee26db5011c0def3ff5b9c03a8b5b8f9615", "target_id": "ru-en85-u043-b0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "f9b6fe18d1818f1f807b898cae5b9996a83d37cda0077c69acdce1953a4ca9ab"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 41, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u043-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Traddles said ‘Exactly so,’ and became pretty red in the face.", "sha256": "5f473d199f86454eb152945532b051f3f7b29cfe2868e6581fbd34735ef0e9a9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Now, although I had not received any express encouragement as yet, I fancied that I saw in the two little sisters, and particularly in Miss Lavinia, an intensified enjoyment of this new and fruitful subject of domestic interest, a settling down to make the most of it, a disposition to pet it, in which there was a good bright ray of hope. I thought I perceived that Miss Lavinia would have uncommon satisfaction in superintending two young lovers, like Dora and me; and that Miss Clarissa would have hardly less satisfaction in seeing her superintend us, and in chiming in with her own particular department of the subject whenever that impulse was strong upon her. This gave me courage to protest most vehemently that I loved Dora better than I could tell, or anyone believe; that all my friends knew how I loved her; that my aunt, Agnes, Traddles, everyone who knew me, knew how I loved her, and how earnest my love had made me. For the truth of this, I appealed to Traddles. And Traddles, firing up as if he were plunging into a Parliamentary Debate, really did come out nobly: confirming me in good round terms, and in a plain sensible practical manner, that evidently made a favourable impression.", "sha256": "a6a715f2629ba3366e178ab2a4df7dad530c3189b340daec63fae422b3bcc004", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I speak, if I may presume to say so, as one who has some little experience of such things,’ said Traddles, ‘being myself engaged to a young lady—one of ten, down in Devonshire—and seeing no probability, at present, of our engagement coming to a termination.’", "sha256": "6552f00c53ad02f8ad7bd83a90bf4070f638841351391da10e4ee0ac4798487e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You may be able to confirm what I have said, Mr. Traddles,’ observed Miss Lavinia, evidently taking a new interest in him, ‘of the affection that is modest and retiring; that waits and waits?’", "sha256": "9c99581eb67d2dc8f8c971114ae470e112d12b9b6daa07207e9b97ed5f703b23", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Entirely, ma’am,’ said Traddles.", "sha256": "35aa1350efc6a3036bbb2d98ed24c79ab3263adefaa721bc749646cb70c9f301", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Miss Clarissa looked at Miss Lavinia, and shook her head gravely. Miss Lavinia looked consciously at Miss Clarissa, and heaved a little sigh. ‘Sister Lavinia,’ said Miss Clarissa, ‘take my smelling-bottle.’", "sha256": "dad3257e43d246dc3ea810f26787b2bab9c218f790ba5177393d5dcc0c3ca9e9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[70]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0070", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Miss Lavinia revived herself with a few whiffs of aromatic vinegar—Traddles and I looking on with great solicitude the while; and then went on to say, rather faintly:", "sha256": "cbcfa5b710091dd2a3a720789a9b2e45a6c00989d11583160a62a37f059437ca", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[71]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0071", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My sister and myself have been in great doubt, Mr. Traddles, what course we ought to take in reference to the likings, or imaginary likings, of such very young people as your friend Mr. Copperfield and our niece.’", "sha256": "a17bc8afabcc97ee90aace8c2519996a9bc0485bcd265ecac471e4edb8fbd6cb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[72]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0072", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Our brother Francis’s child,’ remarked Miss Clarissa. ‘If our brother Francis’s wife had found it convenient in her lifetime (though she had an unquestionable right to act as she thought best) to invite the family to her dinner-table, we might have known our brother Francis’s child better at the present moment. Sister Lavinia, proceed.’", "sha256": "aa76fd9e681b97fe7a15fc625098df8574619e57c700c9cfa459e0f41d32aa87", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[73]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0073", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Miss Lavinia turned my letter, so as to bring the superscription towards herself, and referred through her eye-glass to some orderly-looking notes she had made on that part of it.", "sha256": "42a972f9c3e3e767107b7faf36369bfa1c9b1487611f233dbc1efd57d39e0458", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[74]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0074", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It seems to us,’ said she, ‘prudent, Mr. Traddles, to bring these feelings to the test of our own observation. At present we know nothing of them, and are not in a situation to judge how much reality there may be in them. Therefore we are inclined so far to accede to Mr. Copperfield’s proposal, as to admit his visits here.’", "sha256": "4108aabb9a5d2882ace34cca2decb5f238ad34390061a77cb2d423508327f27b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[75]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0075", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I shall never, dear ladies,’ I exclaimed, relieved of an immense load of apprehension, ‘forget your kindness!’", "sha256": "d97cd9319e08bf24338595820df8e36bec085f237b9a66071f0a4d6fbdba92f0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[76]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0076", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But,’ pursued Miss Lavinia,—‘but, we would prefer to regard those visits, Mr. Traddles, as made, at present, to us. We must guard ourselves from recognizing any positive engagement between Mr. Copperfield and our niece, until we have had an opportunity—’", "sha256": "28418783ff127841d52df8a5e4263e61991cb6a583fdd962edcd6b4256583a89", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[77]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0077", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Until YOU have had an opportunity, sister Lavinia,’ said Miss Clarissa.", "sha256": "5d4f40abc990c683de4c357ae6e6de997bb33e8d17eb2864c703019d8f033c37", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[78]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0078", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Be it so,’ assented Miss Lavinia, with a sigh—‘until I have had an opportunity of observing them.’", "sha256": "d0043439fd15eafcddf04dbf867ac70885f94bc028469af5e913973c137fe3cd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[79]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0079", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Copperfield,’ said Traddles, turning to me, ‘you feel, I am sure, that nothing could be more reasonable or considerate.’", "sha256": "a764c478d21be6f4b7c397b497aeb1a2bcd75f69316d11aa98f1ce3e3036480b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[80]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0080", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Nothing!’ cried I. ‘I am deeply sensible of it.’", "sha256": "168ef3022f71315318517656ad8699cb0104a415acf1caf587853a717b29d17c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[81]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0081", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘In this position of affairs,’ said Miss Lavinia, again referring to her notes, ‘and admitting his visits on this understanding only, we must require from Mr. Copperfield a distinct assurance, on his word of honour, that no communication of any kind shall take place between him and our niece without our knowledge. That no project whatever shall be entertained with regard to our niece, without being first submitted to us—’ ‘To you, sister Lavinia,’ Miss Clarissa interposed.", "sha256": "e5edd962ec9099b39575af1445f75b67fcab3f72bcfe05c3caf5f75e409b9f29", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[82]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0082", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Be it so, Clarissa!’ assented Miss Lavinia resignedly—‘to me—and receiving our concurrence. We must make this a most express and serious stipulation, not to be broken on any account. We wished Mr. Copperfield to be accompanied by some confidential friend today,’ with an inclination of her head towards Traddles, who bowed, ‘in order that there might be no doubt or misconception on this subject. If Mr. Copperfield, or if you, Mr. Traddles, feel the least scruple, in giving this promise, I beg you to take time to consider it.’", "sha256": "db587706b35f5aae3b93c5442b621576bfdcd8557c589a48f9a8c43308ee8699", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[83]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0083", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I exclaimed, in a state of high ecstatic fervour, that not a moment’s consideration could be necessary. I bound myself by the required promise, in a most impassioned manner; called upon Traddles to witness it; and denounced myself as the most atrocious of characters if I ever swerved from it in the least degree.", "sha256": "b2547e9a78b3c86d7069149704097e40a3d08c5e078f116986466d49878ab329", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[84]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0084", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Stay!’ said Miss Lavinia, holding up her hand; ‘we resolved, before we had the pleasure of receiving you two gentlemen, to leave you alone for a quarter of an hour, to consider this point. You will allow us to retire.’", "sha256": "daed69a93ec1cf1ea29297b9dd3fa544c2fca3782eb63ea63ad3f8c682c9bfa2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[85]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0085", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was in vain for me to say that no consideration was necessary. They persisted in withdrawing for the specified time. Accordingly, these little birds hopped out with great dignity; leaving me to receive the congratulations of Traddles, and to feel as if I were translated to regions of exquisite happiness. Exactly at the expiration of the quarter of an hour, they reappeared with no less dignity than they had disappeared. They had gone rustling away as if their little dresses were made of autumn-leaves: and they came rustling back, in like manner.", "sha256": "f360c1aa301ad9a1661e9ecebc819335f96816fa0bb3089575e5d331142c5a92", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[86]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0086", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I then bound myself once more to the prescribed conditions.", "sha256": "6e8e3bbe81bdd3865b9bc5e25a73ee0235bf67cdc58f96148569d1fd35906490", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[87]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0087", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Sister Clarissa,’ said Miss Lavinia, ‘the rest is with you.’", "sha256": "915110714ec9e45825e4f68aa914aa32951001c644df5ea749e936780c0a26a7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[88]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0088", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Miss Clarissa, unfolding her arms for the first time, took the notes and glanced at them.", "sha256": "98796ebd97b58f30a019f9f29de770bd834520ed00aacedac36f2801974a8d9a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[89]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0089", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘We shall be happy,’ said Miss Clarissa, ‘to see Mr. Copperfield to dinner, every Sunday, if it should suit his convenience. Our hour is three.’", "sha256": "cc08e7bff7ee8833956dadd4622faddc61c6eb857f0162266579397830dcd5cd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[90]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0090", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I bowed.", "sha256": "6f6a8df1afeea60a30985c40bd7a431083a4aac011d713c9db5e06e3d804f258", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[91]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0091", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘In the course of the week,’ said Miss Clarissa, ‘we shall be happy to see Mr. Copperfield to tea. Our hour is half-past six.’", "sha256": "1a7f0eb4cfdcfaab77bfb62d25501e491ea45b35106151d7b41ebf2690e6b141", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[92]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0092", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I bowed again.", "sha256": "8f169cdcea57448d0c8b2f9ae9ae738fcf7290efc555243f62f4e031e6ebd0ad", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[93]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0093", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Twice in the week,’ said Miss Clarissa, ‘but, as a rule, not oftener.’", "sha256": "2171a201a3566b4ba848b4db486bf2012d24bb128cc840813094301c2a04ae68", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[94]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0094", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I bowed again.", "sha256": "8f169cdcea57448d0c8b2f9ae9ae738fcf7290efc555243f62f4e031e6ebd0ad", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[95]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u043-b0095", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Miss Trotwood,’ said Miss Clarissa, ‘mentioned in Mr. Copperfield’s letter, will perhaps call upon us. When visiting is better for the happiness of all parties, we are glad to receive visits, and return them. When it is better for the happiness of all parties that no visiting should take place, (as in the case of our brother Francis, and his establishment) that is quite different.’", "sha256": "c7b849b9e41d201ce27c07b11def7f7a45fdbb147a5518d8e9e8fc0631443871", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[48]/p[96]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
